title: Growing-Family Marginal Cost (2nd+ Child)
description: Stack the true marginal cost of a second or later child against your current one-child baseline: USDA-stamped scale factors for housing, transport, food, healthcare, and other spend, childcare that stacks near full price after any sibling discount, flat FSA and child-tax-credit caps that do not scale, and the compound growth lost while savings are paused. Outputs gross and net monthly marginal, an 18-year total including lost compound, and levers ranked by monthly relief (nanny-share switch, unused FSA headroom, new-child credit).
data_vintage: Marginal scale-factor defaults are the USDA Expenditures on Children by Families report (2015-16 CEX, final edition) two-child ratios; FSA household cap $5,000 and child tax credit $2,200 are 2025-26 figures. All defaults are editable and every family figure is user-supplied; the tool holds no live or refreshable data.

mcp_tool_definition.name: growing_family_marginal_cost
mcp_tool_definition.description: Stack the marginal monthly and 18-year cost of a second or later child against the household's current baseline, using USDA two-child scale factors for scaled categories, direct quotes for new-child care with a sibling discount, flat FSA and child-tax-credit offsets, and the compound cost of paused savings. Returns the breakdown, levers ranked by monthly relief.
